The minimap is off by default, and it shipped earlier as v33.36 (`cw-mmoff`). I took the pictures this run but did not re-run the check, so the pass result is from the earlier ship, and I didn't look at the two-window case.

- **Setting:** the existing MINIMAP row in Settings now has "off" as its first and default choice. I removed the old separate on/off row.
- **Old saves:** a save that holds a minimap size moves to off once. It uses a one-time flag, P.mmOff1, in the profile, so `salvagerun:profile` is unchanged.
- **Raid:** the 4K raid picture shows no minimap, and the run info panel sits directly under the money block. The 1080 raid picture was taken in the earlier run.
- **Pictures:** raid at 1080 and 4K, and Settings with the row showing off, are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/shots/82-after/`. The row is below the fold in the display-section picture, so the "off" picture is `27-settings-scroll-600-1080.jpg`.
- **Not done:** a look at both 2-player windows. They share one setting code path, so each follows its own setting and defaults to off, but I did not see it.

I didn't ship anything this run. I changed no game code, so there's nothing for him to watch beyond the minimap being gone on his next play.

TASK DONE
